entry.title: MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp - Releases - 2026-10-22
entry.content:
v4.0.0-preview.1

This is the first preview of v4.

v4 is a ground-up redesign: more than twice the performance, stronger security by default, full Native AOT support, and many new features, including support for C# 14 union types.

The basic API shape is unchanged, and v4 is feature-compatible and wire-compatible with v3 (v3 and v4 read each other’s output). It does, however, contain many breaking changes; see the v4 README and its “Migrating from v3” section before upgrading.

Please report any problems in the Issues.
